QuestInfo.name: Find the Crumpled Piece of Paper Again
QuestInfo.0: You have lost the list of informants you retrieved from the hut in the swamp region. What to do...? Let's go see #bJM#k again.
QuestInfo.1: JM scowls and scoffs at you. He says he'll provide you with the list of informants again, but asks you to pay #ba fee of 2000 Mesos#k. He then instructs you to leave the payment inside the trashcan. Head over to #b#m103030100##k.
QuestInfo.2: You have taken the list of informants out and left 2000 Mesos inside the trash can.

0.0: 흠... 다일에 관한 음모의 실마리는 찾은 건가? 뭐? 정보원 목록을 잃어버렸다고? 누군가 목록을 주워 보기라도 하면 어쩔 거야?! 정보원은 비밀이 생명이라는 것 몰라?!
0.1: 휴우... 이번만은 넘어가 주도록 하지. 하지만 다음 번에는 용서 없을 테니, 주의하라고. 다시 한 번 위험한 크로코1로 가서 정보를 받도록 해. 물론 정해진 시간에만 정보를 얻을 수 있어.

yes.0: 실수에 대한 대가로 이번에는 정보료를 받겠어. 쓰레기통 안에 2000메소를 넣어 놓고 정보를 가져가도록 해.

no.0: 뭐야? 다시 할 자신이 없다는 건가?

0.0: Hmm... Have you found any clues about #o6220000#? What? You've lost the list of informants? What if someone finds the list?! Don't you know that secrecy is the most important aspect of being an informant?!
0.1: Whew... I'll tell the informants to find the lost list... But, I will not go easy on you next time. Go back to #b#m103030100##k and get the list.

yes.0: Of course, you can only receive the list during certain hours. You haven't forgotten, have you? It's #bfrom 5 p.m. to 8 p.m.#k Oh, I'm going to have to charge you a fee for your mistake. Put #b2000 Mesos#k in the trash can before taking the list.
yes.1: Give me an update after you gather all the information from the informants on the list. I'll let you know which ones are valid and which ones are not.

1.0: #b(You feel something rustling inside the dusty trash can. Would you like to take it out of the trash can?)#k
1.1: #b(You have taken out a crumpled piece of paper covered in cobwebs.)#k

npc.0: I guess you haven't been to #m107000301# yet... It's the hut in #b#m107000300#. You can only find the information if you go #bfrom 5 p.m. to 8 p.m.#k. And don't forget to take #b2000 Mesos#k too.
